name: Sheraton Grande Sukhumvit
positioning: Sheraton Grande Sukhumvit, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Bangkok: a Sukhumvit hotel linked by covered skywalk to Asok BTS and Sukhumvit MRT, with a free-form pool in a tropical garden, Thai-themed suites and 24-hour butler service
best_for: Travelers who want easy Skytrain and subway access in Sukhumvit
Couples who want a Thai-themed suite with its own garden
Families who want a Family Suite with a Kids' Corner

facts.text: The hotel is connected by covered skywalk to Asok BTS and Sukhumvit MRT stations.
Terminal 21 mall is directly connected to the hotel.
Select rooms and suites have views of Lake Ratchada or the city skyline.
Rooms have locally inspired decor of teak wood and Thai silk.
Rooms and suites feature Luxury Collection bedding, bathtubs and 24-hour butler service.
The Rama, Rajah and Rachada Suites have an authentic Thai-themed design and lush gardens.
Select suites have a whirlpool tub and a private outdoor garden or balcony.
Family Suites accommodate up to six guests and have separate living areas and a Kids' Corner.
The hotel has a free-form swimming pool and The Grande Spa.
The pool is surrounded by a lush tropical garden.
Dine in the Dark serves a surprise 4-course menu in complete darkness, served by visually impaired hosts.
Guests can learn the art of lotus folding with the hotel's florist and concierge.

highlights.text: The hotel is connected by covered skywalk to Asok BTS and Sukhumvit MRT stations, with Terminal 21 mall directly connected.
A free-form swimming pool surrounded by a lush tropical garden, plus The Grande Spa.
The Rama, Rajah and Rachada Suites have an authentic Thai-themed design and lush gardens.
Rooms and suites feature Luxury Collection bedding, bathtubs and 24-hour butler service.
Dine in the Dark serves a surprise 4-course menu in complete darkness, served by visually impaired hosts.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes a busy urban setting with high foot traffic.
The Grande Spa requires an appointment.
